full_judgment: 17. It appears that the High Court Division sent the case back on remand for retrial vide judgment and order dated 04.11.2002 in Civil Revision No.02 of 1985. It also appears that the plaintiffs filed application for amendment of the plaint under Order-VI Rule-17 praying to insert two facts in the plaint regarding R.S. Khatian and a decree passed in the Title Appeal No.130 of 1992. Plaintiffs filed the suit in 1975 and R.S. survey started to operate in the area from around 1990. So both the facts argued by the plaintiffs were subsequent development to the institution of the suit and in no way change the nature and character of the suit for declaration of title.
